document.title: PER-12/PJ/2026: Perubahan PER-11/PJ/2025 (pelaporan SPT di Coretax)

delta.note: This educational material on PER-12/PJ/2026 covers only administration and reporting. It deals with the correction (pembetulan) mechanism for SPT Masa PPh 21/26, PPh Unifikasi, PPN and Annual SPT, with compensation balance adjustments and the signing of withholding slips. It does not change any rate, PTKP, TER table, deduction, rounding, or calculation step of PPh 21 for permanent employees.
